name: Mary of Bethany
bio: Mary of Bethany sat at Jesus's feet listening to him while her sister Martha busied herself serving, during a visit to their village; when Martha complained, Jesus commended Mary for choosing the one necessary thing (Luke 10:38-42). She is a different figure from Mary the mother of Jesus and Mary Magdalene. When her brother Lazarus died, Mary stayed in the house until her sister Martha secretly told her Jesus had come and was calling for her; she then fell at Jesus's feet, telling him, as Martha had, that her brother would not have died had he been there. Seeing her weeping, along with the mourning crowd that followed her, Jesus was deeply moved and wept himself, before raising Lazarus from the dead (John 11:1-44).
